Name: Animated Low Ponytails for FS (Ayla's Ponytails)
Author: LooneyLuny
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/2mjbfye.png[/img][/center]
[center]I started designing this hair a long time ago, and FINALLY I'm happy with it! My main save character[/center]
[center]was based on my OC, Ayla, and I've been wanting to make something closer to her hairstyle since I[/center]
[center]started modding. And at long last she finally looks more like herself! ♡[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]I also made a modification of the hairbow from my farm dresses mod and added the single flower[/center]
[center]from my flower crowns mod to it as a combo. These can be colored individually. They may not fit[/center]
[center]on other hair shapes though.[/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Below is a video preview of the animation, but the quality isn't the best. ( ╥ω╥ )[/center]
